Two permutation power sums constrain orthomorphism polynomials to affine or quartic, with the exact 35-plus-98 triple counts. Exact incidence then yields all 85,900,584 rank counts. Independently, Gaussian period identities over F7 give squared multiplier counts 0:18,7:18,14:12,49:1. Fourier inversion of the 18 invisible frequencies gives range kernel numerators 31 once, -4 eighteen times and 3 thirty times, so the L1/Linf norm is 193/49. Translation-averaging makes this globally minimal over all projections. Three exact programs, one exhaustive over all masks and another over all permutation maps, plus a cyclotomic check, successfully replayed; the all-projection claim is algebraically proven, not inferred from finite tests.
